newsitem.title: UK: More than three bidders signed ScotAm agreements.
newsitem.headline: More than three bidders signed ScotAm agreements.

text.p: Scottish Amicable, the mutually owned insurer, has signed confidentiality agreements with more than three potential bidders, a source close to the deal said on Thursday.
Until now only three companies were rumoured to have signed the agreements - Abbey National and Prudential Corp and Australian Mutual Provident (AMP).
"It's certainly more than three," said the source.

The agreements allow access to detailed financial information on ScotAm, allowing bidders to finalise their offers for the group. ScotAm refused to comment, declining to disclose either the number or the identity of the bidders.
Earlier, ScotAm said all bidders would be requested to table firm offers by February 28.

Abbey National has already tabled a bid of up to 1.4 billion pounds for ScotAm. That was topped by a 1.9 billion pound offer from Prudential, though both are expected to be revised during the auction process.
